Use this prompt pattern in agent mode:

Generate a Requirements Catalog in Output\Agent_1_uiux-requirements-catalog-generator.

Figma Scope:
<Journey Name>

HLD Scope:
<Feature / Module Name>

Output File:
<filename.md>

Optional Figma Source:
<path or blank>

Optional HLD Source:
<path or blank>

Rules:

Use only scoped content.
Ignore unrelated journeys/screens/HLD sections.
Generate only Requirements Catalog (no test cases).
Include Traceability Notes with [Figma]/[HLD] tags.
Include Missing Requirements.
=============================================
Example:

Generate a Requirements Catalog.

Figma Scope:
Mobile PLP

HLD Scope:
Sales Calculator - New Customer

Output File:
mobile_plp_flow_from_figma.md

If you omit source paths, the agent will auto-discover files and ask you to choose when multiple candidates exist.
